The best fit used P, P·ln P, P², t, and P-weighted and additive sinusoids with free frequencies. Its frequency fits are poorly conditioned (one P-weighted cosine has a frequency near 0.003 and a huge coefficient), so I would not trust it as the law.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0]*P + params[1]*P*np.log(P) + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*t
            + params[4]*np.cos(params[5]*t+params[6])*P + params[7]*np.sin(params[8]*t+params[9]))
